reads.AORT: mixed — a recall and −78% EPS-revision hit a franchise still growing double-digit with rising absolute EBITDA and forward-multiple compression.
reads.BRBR: strongly-bearish — margin AND absolute EBITDA fell together with a ~41% consensus cut and management framing the promotional/cost squeeze as persistent.
reads.CNXC: mixed — cash-generative and near-historic-low multiple, but high above-peer leverage, collapsed GAAP earnings, and volume erosion in key verticals cut both ways.
reads.EPAM: mixed — a still-growing, net-cash, AI-scaling business sits against a ~72pp idiosyncratic de-rate, margin compression and falling second-half visibility.
reads.FUBO: mixed — a contractually-supported merger EBITDA ramp and deep revenue-multiple discount sit against heavy cash burn, shrinking subs and a -34% consensus cut.
reads.IT: mixed — a franchise-quality subscription model (high ROIC, rising absolute EBITDA, growing CV) de-rated on genuine growth-stall and demand-headwind evidence.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — stated going-concern doubt with a near-term maturity wall against thin cash while adjusted EBITDA has turned negative and revenue is contracting.
reads.NCNO: mixed-to-bullish — forward multiples undercut peers with superior margins and rising EBITDA estimates, but decelerating growth leaves the discount arguably part-earned.
reads.SMPL: mixed — genuine growth-brand momentum and a clean balance sheet against a real, guidance-confirmed consumption-and-margin deterioration with heavy downward revisions.
reads.VITL: mixed — a fixable self-inflicted price-gap/margin reset on an unlevered balance sheet, but forward EBITDA cut ~97% with cash burning and recovery deferred to 2027.
reads.VRRM: mixed — a real >10%-customer loss and falling forward estimates offset a self-funding, growing-Government core trading at a post-shock ~4x.
